seo_title: Cloud Data Anonymization API: Ensure B2B GDPR Compliance
seo_desc: Avoid GDPR fines. We integrate a Cloud API for data masking that anonymizes sensitive information before sending it to third-party services.
author_pitch: I have seen dozens of companies face massive fines for sharing customer data with external tools. My mission is to design Cloud architectures that protect your information in real-time, allowing you to use any global API without sacrificing privacy or violating GDPR.
title: B2B Cloud Anonymization API: Protect Your Data from Third Parties | LANZAESTUDIO
body:
Are you sending your customers' data to external APIs and cloud tools without filtering it?

B2B SMEs use dozens of SaaS and APIs (CRMs, AI engines, analytics) to operate daily. By sending unprocessed names, emails, or financial data to these third-party services, they expose the PII (Personally Identifiable Information) of their users, violating GDPR and risking devastating fines, leaks, and service interruptions.

The trap of blind trust

Believing that third-party Cloud providers will detect and anonymize your sensitive data for you is a fatal mistake. Your data sovereignty is your legal and technical responsibility, not your provider's.

Our solution: Serverless Data Masking Middleware

At LANZAESTUDIO, we deploy a Proxy API in your own Cloud infrastructure that acts as a bidirectional privacy shield. Before any request leaves for an external API, our system intercepts it, masks it in milliseconds, and ensures that only 100% safe information travels.

  1. Real-Time Interception: We capture outgoing requests to third-party APIs at the network layer, without adding noticeable latency to your applications.
  2. Automatic PII Redaction: We instantly identify and replace IDs, bank cards, emails, and names with secure cryptographic tokens.
  3. Serverless Architecture: We design an auto-scaling middleware with pay-as-you-go pricing, avoiding bottlenecks and overloads on your main server.
  4. Secure Data Rehydration: Upon receiving the response from the external API, our proxy internally restores the tokens to their original values so your software operates normally.

The Real Impact on your B2B Company

  • Guaranteed GDPR Compliance: Pass any legal audit by technically demonstrating that no personal data leaves your secure corporate environment.
  • Risk-Free Tech Adoption: Integrate any artificial intelligence or global SaaS tool without worrying about data residency regulations.
  • Total Breach Protection: If the external provider suffers a hack, the compromised information will be completely useless to attackers as it is tokenized.
